description.narrative: The project will be implemented by UNDP Georgia and will support reform agenda of the Government of Georgia and its institution building through providing consultancy assistance to the government requested small scale sub-projects, namely a) providing policy advice through on-demand consultancy services and b) developing capacities of public institutions.

description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The overall goal of the contribution was "to contribute to human development through further strengthening government capacity in the implementation of public sector reforms with particular emphasis on further democratisation, sustainable development and rapprochement to the European Union" The expected outcome was that the capacity of the government for the implementation of the public sector reforms would be strengthened through contribution to transformational change of the supported institutions. The project has placed particular focus on policy, institution and capacity development activities that would contribute to the process of rapprochement to EU values, principles and norms.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
